newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee steady v dlr, RBI to issue report.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee steady v dlr, RBI to issue report.

text.p: Spot Indian rupee was trading unchanged at 35.80/81 against the dollar on Tuesday, sustained by moderate dollar demand from state-run companies, dealers said.
Forward dollar premiums opened a shade lower on Tuesday, tracking lower overnight call money rates, dealers said.
A report on rupee convertibility to be released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Tuesday afternoon is unlikely to have any immediate impact on the market, some dealers said.
"Full convertibility is two to three years away," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
